def taller_within(a: list[int], k: int) -> list[int]:
    n = len(a)
    vals = sorted(set(a))
    rank = {v: i + 1 for i, v in enumerate(vals)}
    m = len(vals)
    tree = [0] * (m + 1)

    def add(p, d):
        while p <= m:
            tree[p] += d
            p += p & -p

    def prefix(p):
        s = 0
        while p > 0:
            s += tree[p]
            p -= p & -p
        return s

    res = [0] * n
    hi = 0  # next index to add into the window
    lo = 0  # next index to remove from the window
    size = 0
    for i in range(n):
        while hi < i:
            add(rank[a[hi]], 1)
            size += 1
            hi += 1
        while lo < i - k:
            add(rank[a[lo]], -1)
            size -= 1
            lo += 1
        res[i] = size - prefix(rank[a[i]])
    return res
